category: Purview, DLP & data security for Copilot
title: Audit Copilot interactions in Microsoft Purview
problem: Security asks: who used Copilot, when, and which resources were referenced?
steps: Make sure auditing is on (Exchange Online PowerShell): `Connect-ExchangeOnline` then `Get-AdminAuditLogConfig | FL UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled`
Purview > Audit > search with activity 'Interacted with Copilot' (record type CopilotInteraction).
Export results; files, sites and other resources Copilot accessed are listed in the AuditData.
pitfalls: Audit records contain metadata (who, when, where, resources), not the prompt text — use eDiscovery or DSPM activity explorer for content.
Other AI apps use different record types (e.g. ConnectedAIAppInteraction, AIAppInteraction).
